From the bestselling author of the DCI Matilda Darke series, comes a brand new standalone to keep you on the edge of your seat.

***

‘A powerhouse of a book… Incredible’ Jane Casey

'Tense, atmospheric… A first-class crime novel that already feels like a classic’ Elly Griffiths

‘Unputdownable… Michael Wood [is] a force to be reckoned with’ Sophie Hannah

‘Michael Wood’s books are the gold standard of crime writing… a gripping crime thriller and a forensic exploration of how a murder can destroy an entire community’ Trevor Wood

***

When a body is found in the woods following a ferocious storm it appears to be an open and closed case. But something doesn’t add up, and what seemed a tragic accident soon turns into a murder investigation.

As the police come under pressure to solve the tragedy and with no witnesses, their case is falling apart. Until they find their suspect: an outsider with no alibi.

When the suspect confesses to the crime, the police are happy to close the case. But what if there was foul play involved? What if someone is about to get away with murder…

***

*The ebook and paperback includes bonus chapters and additional content from the audio*

***

‘Absolutely brilliant’ Angela Marsons

‘A page-turner of a thriller… will keep you reading long into the night’ Catherine Cooper

‘Tense and compelling… Michael Wood at his very best’ Sarah Ward

‘A read-in-one sitting thriller’ B P Walter

‘Drew me in and held me in its grip until the very last page… read it immediately!’ Marion Todd

About the author

Michael Wood is a CWA shortlisted author of more than twenty crime fiction novels including the bestselling DCI Matilda Darke series, the Dr Olivia Winter psychological thriller series, and several standalone novels. Born and raised in Sheffield, Michael now lives in Newcastle where he writes full time.
